cells.note: Housekeeping 77: Ley 3/2020 is in force (GNQ-001), and the 2025 peer review asks for decrees to be brought into line with it (GNQ-003), so no rule made under it is held. The council's 2022 fines notice (GNQ-002) applies the law but cannot carry the cell past 3 (ruling 114).
